title: A leaf that declared no documentation is reported as documented, with the enclosing record's text
rationale: The baseline against which the dead-control fixture is read. Inheritance is a deliberate feature and isDocInherited is the honest flag, but the fact remains that a consumer receives, for a column, documentation the producer never wrote about that column. In a governance pipeline that text propagates into a data dictionary. Accepted because inheritance is intentional, bounded to the nearest ancestor, and flagged - and because the consumer can recover the truth from isDocInherited.
catchesBugClass: Inheritance reaching past the nearest ancestor, or the docInherited flag not being set on an inherited doc, which would make the loss unrecoverable rather than merely present.
cannotCatch: It cannot show whether any consumer actually reads isDocInherited. It says nothing about property inheritance, which uses a different mechanism with different shadowing rules.

predicted.detail: Every declared doc is null; every reported doc is an ancestor's text with inherited=true.

configDescription: assert ENRICHED_METADATA vs DECLARED_DOC, default FlattenOptions (inheritDoc defaults true)
